chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of them عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ; he said:
I asked him about walking with the funeral procession, and he said: “In front of it, on its right side, on its left side, and behind it.”

key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral procession or bier being accompanied
key_terms.بَيْنَ: in front of or ahead in this context

ai.seo_question: Where may one walk in relation to the funeral procession according to the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about accompanying a funeral procession. It indicates that walking with the janazah is permissible in front of it, on its right, on its left, and behind it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.464 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of them (Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) or Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) ) that he asked about walking with the funeral procession.
Imam (as) replied: "In front of it, on its right side, on its left side, and behind it."
